newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 18.

text.p: These are significant stories in the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- West African experts meet to examine future of Lome Convention defining trade links between African, Asian and Caribbean states with the European Union.
- Customs check points still present on Abengourou-Akoupe road despite government order that all such barriers inside the the country be removed.

- Street vendors of unauthorised medicines request for extra time to wind up their trade following a government crackdown. - More than 200 illegal gold diggers arrested in police operation around Ity gold mine in eastern Ivory Coast.
- Uncertainty over future of Afro-Asian and Pacific group's relations with the European Union as regional experts examine Lome IV convention.
